name: Buho Store
description: Uruguayan online store selling home organization and decor: organizers, baskets, shelves, textiles, kitchen and bath accessories, tableware, lighting and candles. Ships nationwide with store pickup in Montevideo.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de organización y decoración del hogar: organizadores, canastos, estantes, textiles, accesorios de cocina y baño, vajilla, iluminación y velas. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro en tienda en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide; free over a stated threshold in 1-3 business days; same-day in Montevideo and Ciudad de la Costa; interior via DAC or Mirtrans

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at two Montevideo stores (Libres and Luis Alberto de Herrera addresses listed on the shipping page).
